scripts.android:dev: APP_VARIANT=development expo prebuild --platform android --no-install --clean && cd android && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a
scripts.android:e2e: APP_VARIANT=e2e expo prebuild --platform android --no-install --clean && cd android && ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease -PreactNativeArchitectures=${E2E_ABI:-arm64-v8a}
scripts.ios:e2e: APP_VARIANT=e2e expo prebuild --platform ios --no-install --clean && cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace NodE2E.xcworkspace -scheme NodE2E -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build ARCHS=arm64 -quiet
scripts.ios:release: expo prebuild --platform ios --no-install --clean && cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace Nod.xcworkspace -scheme Nod -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath build/Nod.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=$APPLE_TEAM_ID CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Automatic archive -quiet
